name: test-on-save
description: Run parser/unit/property tests when addon or companion source changes.

then.comment: Runs whichever suites exist; harmless no-op before test scaffolding lands.
then.command: sh -c 'set -e; if [ -f addon/tests/run.lua ] && command -v lua >/dev/null 2>&1; then lua addon/tests/run.lua; fi; if [ -f companion/src-tauri/Cargo.toml ] && command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd companion/src-tauri && cargo test); fi'
